title: Path traversal
guidance: Resolve user-selected paths against an approved root and enforce containment after canonicalization. Prefer server-owned identifiers over raw paths. Account for symlinks and file-system races. Test encoded traversal, absolute paths and legitimate files; checking a substring or removing one occurrence of dot-dot is not sufficient.

title: Server-side request forgery
guidance: Limit outbound requests to approved destinations and protocols. Validate resolved addresses and redirect destinations, and enforce network egress restrictions. Review DNS changes and access to private, loopback, link-local and metadata services. A user-controlled URL alone does not establish that a protected destination is reachable.

title: Open redirect
guidance: Prefer fixed application-owned redirect targets or map opaque identifiers to approved locations. Parse and validate the final destination against the expected origin or explicit allowlist. Test scheme-relative URLs, encoded separators and lookalike hosts. A prefix check on an unparsed URL is insufficient.
